name: Hotel AlpenSchlössl
beschreibung: The Hotel AlpenSchlössl is located in the municipality of Söll in the federal state of Tirol. The accommodation is situated in a quiet location with views of the surrounding mountain landscape. Guests have access to a sauna and a fitness area. The rooms are equipped with modern comforts. The surrounding area offers opportunities for hiking and skiing. The hotel is equally suitable for those seeking relaxation and active holidaymakers. The region is known for its natural landscape.
